select:
select a.id, a.name, a.`subject`, a.ticket_type, date_format( a.ticket_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS ticket_date, a.ticket_solution, a.ticket_stage, a.stage_code, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS created_time, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName
from jml_internal_ticket a left join jml_staff cs on a.created_staff_id = cs.id
and (a.name like '%${multiFiled}%' or a.desc like '%${multiFiled}%')
and a.created_time >= str_to_date(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and a.created_time <= date_add(str_to_date(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d'),interval 1 day)
and a.ticket_type = #{ticketType}
and a.created_staff_id = #{createdStaffId}
order by a.update_time desc

select a.id, a.name, a.`subject`, a.ticket_type, date_format( a.ticket_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS ticket_date, date_format( a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as update_time, a.ticket_date, a.ticket_solution, a.ticket_stage, a.stage_code, date_format( a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS created_time, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName, us.`name` AS updateStaffName, a.current_acceptance_staff_id, a.close_remark, date_format( a.close_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as close_time, a.close_staff_id, c.name as closeStaffName, a.solution_desc, a.desc from jml_internal_ticket a left join jml_staff cs on a.created_staff_id = cs.id left join jml_staff us ON a.update_staff_id = us.id left join jml_staff c ON a.close_staff_id = c.id
a.id=#{id}
